clarification: The cross-family QUALIFICATION router selection reuses the already frozen router HPO objective: maximize min(controlled_zero/C_cold - 1, warm/C_seq - 1 + 0.10), with the declared zero-denominator rule; ties use overall NDCG@20 then family_id ascending.
scope: Makes the preregistered one-router-finalist selection executable without adding a model, metric, population, or outcome-dependent choice.
